name: 25% Capital Investment Subsidy Scheme
benefit: 1. Under the scheme, financial assistance of 25 % of the total cost of the Enterprise inclusive of land, machinery, and construction limited to the maximum amount of ₹6.25 lakhs will be provided to the eligible entrepreneurs.
_eligibility_text:
1. Any individual above 18 years of age including Women, ex-servicemen &amp; physically handicapped is eligible to apply under the scheme.
   1. New Micro or Small units engaged in manufacturing/servicing except the activities specified in the **Negative List** are eligible to claim a 25% Capital Investment Subsidy established in Lakshadweep Islands.   1. Micro Enterprises/Units, where the investment in Plant &amp; Machinery and Building below ₹25.00 Lakhs is only eligible under this Scheme.
   1. The Entrepreneurs Memorandum Part-II (Permanent Registration) under the MSME Act 2006 filed before the Director of Industries, U.T. of Lakshadweep or Udyog Aadhar registration/otherwise shall be eligible for availing subsidy under this scheme as per [Annexure-I](https://cdn.s3waas.gov.in/s358238e9ae2dd305d79c2ebc8c1883422/uploads/2019/08/2019082183.pdf).   1. Institutions registered under the Societies Registration Act 1960 and Self-Help Groups that have not availed financial benefits under any other scheme are eligible for a 25% Capital Investment Subsidy.

**Note:** The area of operation of the scheme is in all inhabitant islands of Lakshadweep.
**Negative List of Activities:**
The following list of activities will not be permitted under 25% Capital Investment Subsidy Programmes/ Projects/Units.

   1. Any industry/business connected with the processing/preparing of intoxicated items like Beedi/Pan/Cigarette etc.
   1. Manufacturing of Polythene carry bags of less than 20Microns thickness and manufacture of carry bags or containers made of recycled plastic for storing, carrying, dispensing, or packaging of foodstuff and any other items that cause environmental problems.
